tools.name: codercraft_status
tools.description: Check CoderCraft engine status, active language, and connected MCP servers.

tools.name: codercraft_open_file
tools.description: Open and inspect source file buffer metadata.

tools.name: codercraft_read_file
tools.description: Read line range from file.

tools.name: codercraft_write_file
tools.description: Write or overwrite content to file.

tools.name: codercraft_apply_edit
tools.description: Replace exact target block with replacement string in file.

tools.name: codercraft_grep
tools.description: Search workspace files for matching text.

tools.name: codercraft_extract_symbols
tools.description: Extract AST function, struct, and enum declarations from file.

tools.name: codercraft_index_workspace
tools.description: Index workspace directory, instruction files, and tree.

tools.name: codercraft_plan
tools.description: Generate multi-step architectural implementation plan (Plan Mode).

tools.name: codercraft_refactor
tools.description: Synthesize autonomous AST code refactoring proposal (Build Mode).

tools.name: codercraft_lint
tools.description: Execute active linter on workspace.

tools.name: codercraft_shell
tools.description: Execute shell command in workspace sandbox.

tools.name: codercraft_fleet_depot
tools.description: List all 12 Craft fleet apps, ports, and execution states.

tools.name: codercraft_probe_depot
tools.description: Actively probes TCP ports for all 12 Craft fleet apps and returns latencies.

tools.name: codercraft_fleet_launch
tools.description: Launch a Craft fleet app by name.

tools.name: codercraft_swarm_status
tools.description: Inspect Stigmergic Agent Swarm supervisor workers and task ledger.

tools.name: codercraft_help
tools.description: Get comprehensive CoderCraft help, feature summary, and capabilities.

tools.name: codercraft_compare
tools.description: Detailed architectural comparison matrix: CoderCraft vs Claude Desktop vs OpenCode vs AGY.

tools.name: codercraft_apply_patch
tools.description: Apply multi-file patch with OpenCode markers (*** Add File / *** Update File / *** Delete File / *** Move to).

tools.name: codercraft_glob
tools.description: Gitignore-aware file glob (supports **, *, ?).

tools.name: codercraft_check_permission
tools.description: Check allow/ask/deny verdict for a mutating tool call before running it.

tools.name: codercraft_session_create
tools.description: Create an eternal-memory chat session.

tools.name: codercraft_session_append
tools.description: Append a turn (user/assistant) to an eternal-memory session.

tools.name: codercraft_session_list
tools.description: List eternal-memory sessions with optional workspace/date filters.

tools.name: codercraft_session_search
tools.description: Full-text search across every session turn (eternal memory elicitation).

tools.name: codercraft_session_recall
tools.description: Recall what was discussed in a calendar month (year + 1-12 month).

tools.name: codercraft_session_read
tools.description: Read one session transcript.

tools.name: codercraft_run
tools.description: Run autonomous goal loop (explore -> act -> verify), every step logged to eternal memory. Returns session_id plus step ledger.

tools.name: codercraft_llm_status
tools.description: LLM provider status: file config (keys redacted) plus reachability probe of the configured provider.

tools.name: codercraft_llm_list_models
tools.description: List models for a provider (live list; curated only for Anthropic with a key).

tools.name: codercraft_llm_select
tools.description: Select provider + model, persist it, and switch VRAM (Ollama evicts others and warms the pick).

tools.name: codercraft_llm_set_key
tools.description: Store a cloud provider API key in ~/.craft/ai_config.json. Never echoed back.

tools.name: codercraft_llm_evict
tools.description: Evict Ollama residents; keep one warm when given.

tools.name: codercraft_llm_test
tools.description: Probe the configured brain with a short completion (90s cap).
